description: An older male meditation guide with a warm, grounded low register. Quiet confidence, unhurried but natural articulation, modest emotional range and gentle sentence endings. Intimate conversational speech, not a theatrical narrator. No whispering, chanting, exaggerated breathiness or imitated accent.

sv.source: Local Piper sv_SE-nst-medium; KBLab Swedish NST model (CC0)
sv.text: Du behöver inte åstadkomma något här. Ta ett lugnt andetag. Du kan bara vara här en stund.

en.source: Local Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign 1.7B 8bit; original synthetic English Zen voice
en.text: There is nothing you need to achieve here. Let your shoulders soften. Take your time. For this moment, you can simply be here.
